description: Changes one step of one lead's follow-ups, as the journey list does. Send one or more of: dueAt (ISO time, or null for the plan's timing; must stay after the step before it), channel ('message', 'email', 'call', 'reply', or null for the plan), removed (true takes it out, false puts it back), keep: true (its custom text is still right after the latest conversation). Or addAfter ('message', 'email', 'call' or 'reply') alone to add a step after it (the new step's id comes back). The step's words are your person's to change in the app. step_id comes from the lead's journey. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_lead_step
title: Change a step in a lead's follow-ups
